# product-bench

Draft discovery plans, prototypes, PRDs with Gherkin acceptance criteria, design specs and engineering projects from a product brief. Every output is a draft a person approves.

A [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com) plugin bundling 7 agent skills.

## Install

This directory is also a single-plugin marketplace. From Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add <path-or-git-url-to-this-directory>
/plugin install product-bench@product-bench
```

## Default icon

fanout includes a default fan icon at `.claude-plugin/icon.png`. You can replace
it with your own square PNG (512–2048 px, under 2 MB) before submitting this
plugin to Claude's directory. Rebuilding with fanout restores the default;
reapply your icon afterward or use a custom platform template.
